response.title: Corn stover to ethanol, the NREL 2011 design
response.description: The corn stover ethanol biorefinery the BioSTEAM authors built to the NREL design report (Humbird et al. 2011, NREL/TP-5100-47764): pretreatment, enzymatic hydrolysis, co-fermentation, distillation, wastewater treatment and a boiler, run whole on the package's own defaults. The benchmark: it shows this installation simulates and prices a published biorefinery as its authors do.
response.priceBasis: USD per gallon of ethanol, at the package's own ethanol density
